audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads TRICKY at 7/10 with Pantheon carry threat 7.5/10, but the matchup is 50.96% over 1566 games and the content-layer chart hands Galio five of seven stages. The rating and the chart argue opposite cases.
audit.why: 50.96% is a coin flip, not a 7/10 problem lane. I did not move diff or diffRating because they are part of the same unresolved chart conflict described in notes — changing the rating without the chart would deepen the disagreement rather than fix it.
audit.corrected: Needs a ruling: either diff drops toward EVEN/5.5 or the content chart is wrong. See questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is attributed to 'Grand Skyfall' in whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid, wants.foe[2] and wants.you[3]. No such ability exists.
audit.why: Pantheon's R is Grand Starfall: 180/165/150s, 5500 range, 'composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet'. packet.suspectNames flags the name at edit distance 3. spikes[0].text also says 'he has no shield until W is up' — W is Shield Vault, the 600-range dash-stun; the shield is Aegis Assault (E), 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Grand Starfall, 5500 range on 180s at rank 1 — the same reach as Galio's rank-3 Hero's Entrance. His defensive spike is Aegis Assault (E) on 22s, not W.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Aegis Assault is a channel, or that it only blocks damage from the front — both decide every all-in in this lane.
audit.why: enemyKit E carries the channel flag ('interruptible — any CC cancels it') and Riot's text is explicit: 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.' Galio's W is hard CC and his E is a knockup on an 11s cooldown, so either one ends a 22s ability. missingInteractions also flags that Shield Vault is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell rather than the cast.
audit.corrected: Taunt or knockup cancels Aegis Assault; if you cannot, get behind him rather than pushing damage into the front. Trading his 22s E for your 11s E is the best cooldown swap in the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) despite being the field that governs when you may step forward.
audit.why: Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9 at 600 range, Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18, Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8 at 575 — all in the kit.
audit.corrected: Written in with the behaviour each number gates.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: The titles promise wave-and-R timing and dash discipline; the bodies described a trade rotation.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their own titles using Grand Starfall's 5500/180s and Justice Punch's 11s against Shield Vault's 600 range.
